business_scope.primary_industry_name: Off-Price Wholesale Liquidation of Branded Overstock Apparel

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (International Company regime under the International Companies Act 1987)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English Common Law heritage with indigenous customary law elements; unitary national corporate law regime without sub-national tax distinction
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between Samoa and Australia for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (DTA, signed 2008, in force 2010)
Agreement between Samoa and New Zealand for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (DTA, signed 2009, in force 2011)
Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Independent State of Samoa on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (BIT, signed 1999, in force)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) (regional FTA, in force since 13 December 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended) administered by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) with supervisory oversight by the Central Bank of Samoa; International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) covering register of members, register of directors, and registered agency provisions; Companies Act 2001; International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2001 (as amended); SIFA AML/CFT Guidance Notes and Risk-Based Supervision Framework implementing FATF Recommendations 24 and 25 on beneficial ownership transparency. UBO particulars are held by the licensed registered agent at the Samoan registered office and must be produced to the Registrar of International Companies or the FIU upon lawful demand, court order, or supervisory inspection.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized true copy of passport (bio-data page) of each natural person director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Samoa has not acceded to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; legalization chain: notary -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country of origin -> Embassy or High Commission of Samoa)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (recent utility bill, bank statement, or government-issued certificate) issued within the preceding 90 days
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility company or bank, notarized by a commissioned notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notary -> MFA of origin country -> Samoan consular mission)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker's reference or financial standing letter confirming the source of funds of each subscriber
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or recognized financial institution in the client's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (banker's letter notarized, authenticated by the competent MFA of origin, then legalized by the Samoan consular mission)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate register bundle for any corporate shareholder or UBO: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Memorandum and Articles, board resolution authorizing subscription for the Samoa International Company, register of directors, and UBO declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry and licensed agent of the parent jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (where the parent jurisdiction is an Apostille Party, the apostille may serve only as an intermediate certification; final statutory filing in Samoa requires consular legalization as Samoa has not acceded to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed and witnessed consent to act as director or secretary, together with subscriber signature pages to the Memorandum and Articles of Association, including the full Chinese-language articles variant and a certified English translation deposited for the Registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the signatory's jurisdiction, or execution before a Samoan Commissioner for Oaths when signed in Apia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notary -> MFA of origin -> Samoan consular legalization) or execution before a Samoan Commissioner for Oaths

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-list screening of every director, shareholder, UBO, authorized signatory, and ultimate beneficial owner against the UN Consolidated Security Council Sanctions List, US OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and UK HMT sanctions list, supplemented by the Samoa FIU domestic watchlist, at engagement, upon adverse news, and on a periodic basis of at least quarterly. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), including family members and close associates, trigger enhanced due diligence encompassing source of wealth and source of funds verification, senior management approval, and enhanced transaction monitoring as mandated by the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and SIFA/FIU Guidance Notes. For the off-price apparel liquidation trade, screening extends to business counterparties, freight forwarders, and correspondent or beneficiary banks supporting Swift/Wire and ACH payment rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) online company registration and name reservation portal (sifa.ws), administered by the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour of the Independent State of Samoa; submissions must be filed through a SIFA-licensed registered agent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must be in Roman or Latin characters. A Chinese-language or other non-Latin trade name may be reserved concurrently with a mandatory romanized transliteration and an English rendering for the Registrar's record. Corporate documents, including an all-Chinese Memorandum and Articles of Association, are permissible provided a certified English translation is deposited with the registered agent and the Registrar. The Registrar compares proposed names against existing and reserved names and disallows names that are identical, confusingly similar, misleading, or that contain prohibited or sensitive tokens. The suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' or an approved equivalent is required for an International Company.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Trust (unless the entity holds a valid trust company license)
Government; Ministry; Crown; Royal; State (implying connection with or patronage of a government)
Olympic; United Nations; supranational institutional designations
Any term suggesting sponsorship or authorization by Samoa or a foreign government when no prior ministerial approval has been obtained
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The licensed registered agent may apply for a single extension of the name reservation for an additional 30 days prior to expiry. Upon rejection, the agent must file a formal written appeal with the Chief Executive Officer of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 14 days of the rejection notice, attaching the original rejection notice, a statutory declaration explaining non-confusion and commercial availability, prior ministerial approvals where sensitive tokens are engaged, and a legal opinion addressing inherent distinctiveness. The Chief Executive Officer must decide within 15 working days of the appeal; failure to decide within that period constitutes deemed approval. A further adverse decision may be challenged by judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days. The rejected name may also be re-submitted immediately with a distinct trade name suffix or adjusted transliteration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A statutory registered office and resident registered agent in Apia, Samoa, are mandatory; the office must be the physical premises of a SIFA-licensed registered agent. A purely virtual operation is otherwise permissible for this non-licensed wholesale liquidation business, including remote board meetings, email-written resolutions, and fully outsourced back-office arrangements. The registered agent's virtual office package (mailbox, digital archives, and e-filing) satisfies the statutory address requirement without requiring the company itself to maintain local employees or premises.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low, with an estimated annual probability below 5% of an unannounced physical on-site inspection of the company itself in the non-licensed, low-risk wholesale trade sector. Registered agents remain subject to periodic risk-based supervisory inspections by the Registrar and the Samoa FIU, typically once every two to three years, and surprise inspections may be triggered by sanctions or PEP alerts, adverse media, or correspondent-bank due diligence inquiries.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2001 (as amended)
Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2001, Schedule of Fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office services (first year, including virtual-office mailbox and compliance oversight)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: SIFA-licensed registered agent (resident agent in Apia)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Samoa International Company agent services (USD 300-600 per annum)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of Memorandum and Articles of Association, English plus Chinese bilingual variant with certified English translation for the Registrar
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoan attorney or licensed registered agent (draftsman)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for bilingual offshore constitutional drafting (USD 350-650)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO / KYC / AML compliance file: customer due diligence, PEP and OFAC/UN/EU/UK sanctions screening, risk assessment, and source-of-funds review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent's Money Laundering Reporting Officer / compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard-risk customer due diligence file preparation (USD 120-250)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization bundle for natural-person and corporate KYC documents (passport, address proof, banker's reference, consents, and corporate register bundle, processed through the notary-to-MFA-of-origin-to-Samoan-consular chain)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public; Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country of origin; Embassy or High Commission of Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariffs plus prevailing consular and government legalization fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and secure handling of original certified documents and completed incorporation file

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2014 (Samoa), ss. 6–12 (Incorporation), s. 28 (Registered Office), s. 41 (Directors and Officers); International Companies Regulations 2015
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Companies Unit, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association, filed with Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital required; company may be incorporated with zero issued shares. No escrow account, capital deposit, or proof of payment is required by law; consideration and paid-up capital are determined solely by the subscribers and reflected in the register of members.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers’ share allotment be and is hereby approved and the shares set out in the register of members be issued; FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be situated at Apia, Samoa and the licensed registered agent be retained; FURTHER RESOLVED that the individuals listed in the notice of directors be appointed as the first directors and that [Name] be appointed Company Secretary; RESOLVED FURTHER that the seal, bank mandates, and signatories be adopted as presented, and that the directors be authorised to open bank accounts, engage the liquidator/auditor, and complete all post-incorporation filings under the International Companies Act 2014.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, MCIL (Name Reservation Desk)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name (in English and/or Chinese characters if desired) via the MCIL Companies Registry online portal or in-person counter. Pay the name reservation fee and request sidelines/clearance. Reserve the name for 30 days pending submission of incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Company name in Latin characters (and optional Chinese characters)
Statement of purpose / intended business summary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is declined because it is misleading, confusingly similar, or prohibited, select 2 reserve names and resubmit without additional fee; appeals within 14 days to the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed International Company registered agent / Samoan corporate counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed registered agent in Samoa to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English. Execute the documents before a notary public or by any licensed agent authorized under the International Companies Act. Include the company object of off-price wholesale apparel liquidation whereby the company shall not carry on a physically regulated manufacturing activity.
required_dossiers: Proposed directors and company secretary information (name, address, ID/certificate)
Consent to act forms for directors/secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries clauses (e.g., ultra vires object), amend the Memorandum/Articles through the agent and re-sign; no process re-commencement required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Statutory Declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the signed and notarized Memorandum and Articles, and the statutory declaration of the registered agent confirming compliance with due diligence and the International Companies Act. Submit both hard-copy and digital files via the MCIL one-stop shop / e-registry.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of payment or fee schedule
Applicable AML/KYC due diligence file for ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is flagged as incomplete, the Registry issues a 14-day correction notice; submit the missing notarization or declaration within the cure period to avoid abandonment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour – Finance Division / Ministry of Finance Revenue Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance, pay the official state filing fee of USD 350 (or equivalent in Samoan Tala) by bank transfer to the Samoa Government consolidated revenue account. Retain the receipt; the receipt number must be endorsed on the Registry file.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is misapplied, request a refund/reallocation via the MCIL Finance Division with proof of bank transfer; reconciliation normally completed in 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After verification, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and opens the company register. Verify that the company name, number, date, and registered office align with the application. The registered agent obtains the certified copy and transmits it to the client with the company formation kit.
required_dossiers: Register of members, directors, and secretary (initial ledger)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate shows a clerical error (e.g., name misspelling), tender the certificate to the Registry for re-issue under s. 12 of the Act; no new application required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Setup: Registered Office, Bank Mandate, and First Board Meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed International Company registered agent / Board of Directors / Samoa Commercial Bank (or correspondent bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (physical or by written resolution) to adopt the first board resolution, open the corporate bank account, execute the bank mandate, and file the notice of directors/secretary with the Registry if not already filed. Appoint a liquidator or auditor only if required; no economic substance filing is applicable to passive holding/trading of overstock apparel where the exemption applies.
required_dossiers: First board resolution (minutes or written resolution)
Bank account opening pack (UBO declarations, certificate of incorporation, board resolution, director ID)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank queries beneficial ownership, provide enhanced evidence of business purpose (purchase/sale invoices) or legal counsel opinion; re-file the board mandate with the bank's compliance unit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial license required. The registered business scope (ISIC 4641, wholesale of textiles and clothing; off-price apparel liquidation trading) is ministerial or license-exempt under Schedule 2 of the Samoa Industry Licensing Act.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business Registration (exempt from industrial operating license) — registration under the Business Names/Licensing Act only where a physical trading premises is opened in Samoa; otherwise offshore wholesale trading is not licensed.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) – Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 4 (wholesale trading and warehousing of finished garments, no manufacturing or processing; no full EIA report required). A Construction Permit / Trade Waste Discharge registration is only triggered by physical re-packaging or warehouse operations in Apia.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A — no wastewater or VOC emissions generated by off-price trading. If a future physical warehouse is opened, effluent discharge must align with Samoa Water Authority Trade Waste Standards (max BOD 200 mg/L, COD 350 mg/L, TSS 100 mg/L) and solid waste must be handled under the Waste Management Regulations 2014.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety certificate or structural load inspection is required for a pure offshore trading company with no physical premises in Samoa. If a racking/warehouse facility is later used, the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) must issue a Fire Clearance Certificate, and the Labour and Employment Relations Division must inspect the workplace for OHS compliance (manual handling, electrical wiring, lighting, emergency exits, and fire suppression).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (Inland Revenue Division), Government of Samoa; taxpayer portal: the Ministry for Revenue Online Taxpayer Services portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign legal entities obtain a Samoa Tax Identification Number (TIN) by filing a TIN registration application with the Ministry for Revenue, accompanied by the International Company certificate of incorporation, registered agent certificate, registry search result, directorship and shareholding disclosure, and evidence of the registered office in Samoa. For a non-resident International Company, TIN registration is required only for payroll withholding, VAGST registration, or customs clearance purposes; a separate VAGST registration number is issued when the entity makes taxable supplies in Samoa in excess of the statutory threshold or voluntarily requests registration. The standard SOP is: (1) submit the registration form through the Ministry for Revenue online portal or paper lodgment; (2) provide certified passport copies of each director and shareholder; (3) state the entity classification as a tax-exempt International Company; and (4) receive the TIN certificate and, if applicable, the VAGST registration certificate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (the Samoa International Company is exempt from Samoan income tax and stamp duty under the International Companies Act, as amended; VAGST and customs duty arise only on imports physically entering Samoa or on taxable supplies made in Samoa, not on offshore export sales)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No general check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election regime exists under Samoa law. The tax-exempt status of an International Company attaches automatically by incorporation and does not require an affirmative income tax election. Available statutory elections are limited to: (a) voluntary VAGST registration for a person whose taxable supplies are below the compulsory threshold; (b) an election to apply zero-rating to export supplies; and (c) the structural election to incorporate under the International Companies Act rather than the domestic Companies Act, which fixes the territorial tax exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax), a VAT-model goods and services tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT/WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover (Samoa Tala); foreign non-resident exporters of off-price finished garments must evaluate Samoa place-of-supply and consumption-based nexus rules before assuming a VAGST registration obligation
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, no national e-invoicing clearinghouse, no API clearance requirement, and no digital stamping mandate currently applies in Samoa. Taxpayers issuing VAGST invoices must nonetheless satisfy substantive invoice-content rules by stating the supplier name and VAGST registration number, recipient identification, date, description and quantity of goods, amount charged, the rate of tax, and the tax amount. Paper invoices and PDF invoices are accepted; the Ministry for Revenue has not yet issued a compulsory continuous-transaction-control clearance framework.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Finished garments exported from Samoa, including off-price branded overstock apparel sold by a wholesale liquidation trader, qualify for the 0% VAGST rate when the supplier sells the goods under an export contract, the goods are physically removed from Samoa by or on behalf of the supplier, the risk and title in the goods pass to the overseas buyer, and the exporter retains contemporaneous shipping and payment evidence. Offshore services such as liquidation agency services, marketing, logistics coordination, and trade facilitation supplied to non-resident buyers are also zero-rated where the recipient is outside Samoa, the services are not rendered to a Samoan resident, and the place of effective consumption is outside Samoan territory.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Inward Remittance Certificate / authenticated SWIFT wire incoming evidence
Evidence of foreign buyer identity and purchase order
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may retrospectively claw back zero-rated treatment and input tax credits if the exporter cannot substantiate the physical export, the foreign recipient, or the receipt of sales proceeds within the documentation retention period. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims are subject to statutory penalties, including immediate collection of unpaid VAGST, late payment interest, penalty tax for deliberate tax evasion (commonly assessed at a substantial percentage of the tax shortfall), and criminal prosecution before the Supreme Court of Samoa with potential fines and imprisonment. Exporters should retain the full customs, transport, warehousing, payment, incoterm, and invoice evidence bundle for at least five years, or longer if required by applicable anti-money-laundering record-keeping rules.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is not a freely convertible offshore currency. Exchange control is administered by the Central Bank of Samoa under the Exchange Control Act and accompanying regulations. Current account payments for bona fide trade in goods are generally approved through authorized commercial banks using exchange control forms and supporting trade documents. Profit remittance in the form of dividends may be cleared upon evidence of audited financial statements, tax clearance, and corporate solvency. Capital account inflows, including equity injections and shareholder loans, require prior exchange control approval through the authorized bank or by direct Central Bank application. The practical risk for a finished garments off-price wholesale trader is low-to-moderate for USD-based trade flows, provided the underlying supply contracts and invoices are transparent. Off-market convertibility of WST is thin; therefore USD is the preferred settlement currency via correspondent banking. There are no material restrictions on maintaining USD accounts domestically, but any Samoan-resident entity settlement through non-authorized channels would violate exchange control requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoa does not currently impose a statutory percentage surrender or mandatory conversion of export proceeds into WST. However, all export receipts must be repatriated to a Samoa-authorized dealer bank within the underlying bill of lading period, generally within 180 days from the date of export, unless the Central Bank grants an extension. Export invoices must be submitted with the Exchange Control form through the receiving bank, including shipping documents, commercial invoices, and evidence of the physical goods flow. Without an active surrender obligation, proceeds may remain in USD in a Samoa bank account, but the company must declare the receipt and the bank must evidence that the funds arise from genuine merchandise exports. Holding proceeds offshore without prior Central Bank authorization may constitute an exchange control violation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority_note: Regulated exchange control filings apply regardless of the international company's zero-tax status; tax-exempt status does not eliminate treasury compliance requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD & WST Account
Operational Account / Export Proceeds Collection Account / FX Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Limited viability for fully offshore EMI banking. Samoa's financial licensing framework, including the Financial Institutions Act 2021 and the Central Bank of Samoa regulations, generally requires a licensed presence for money transmission and deposit-taking services with a domestic nexus. Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, or Currencycloud may be used as supplementary collection or disbursement tools for non-Samoan trade flows, but they cannot be used as the primary regulated settlement channel for export proceeds attributable to the Samoa company. Any inbound proceeds to a Samoa company must be routed to an authorized dealer bank and reported through exchange control forms. Fintech platforms can provide USD collection accounts offshore for certain buyers, but final physical settlement should be cleared through a Samoa Licensed Commercial Bank. Legal risk arises if an offshore EMI is used to obscure beneficial ownership or evade the exchange control declaration regime. The recommended approach is a secondary EMI account for buyer-side EUR/USD receipts followed by periodic SWIFT MT103 transfers to the Samoa bank, with each transfer supported by underlying invoices.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors in Samoa is generally required for opening a corporate bank account for an International Company, although some banks may accept video-interview processes through the registered agent at their discretion. Standard onboarding for ANZ/BSP and Samoa Commercial Bank requires at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) to appear for an in-person interview at the bank branch. In exceptional circumstances, if the director cannot travel, a recognized Samoa registered agent with a notarized resolution and certified true document copies may act, but banks retain absolute discretion under their AML/KYC policies and the Anti-Money Laundering and Proliferation Financing Act 2018. Remote opening is uncommon for International Companies without a physical domestic nexus. Practical expectation: face-to-face verification or a high-quality video conference with wet-ink signatures certified by a licensed attorney/registered agent, followed by an in-branch bank officer's call for confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction in the UBO or counterparty chain or sanctions exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed bank KYC forms, passport copies, proof of address, corporate registry excerpts, sanctions screening results, OFAC/commercial database screening report, and a detailed source-of-funds and source-of-wealth declaration supported by audited financial statements or bank references

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transfer pricing or artificial intercompany routing with no local substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution, group structure chart, economic substance memorandum, proof of registered office in Samoa, physical office/registered agent agreement, management accounts, and a transfer pricing benchmark summary showing arm's-length margins for the off-price wholesale apparel business

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering red flags through invoicing mismatch
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices, proforma invoices, purchase orders, bills of lading, packing lists, customs declarations, warehouse receipts, and evidence of the actual goods flow, including photographs or third-party inspection reports if available

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained third-party payments or settlement from non-contractual parties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assignment agreements, purchase order novation notices, buyer side verification, letters from the beneficial owner explaining payment routing, and the invoice-to-payment reconciliation sheet

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transactions velocity relative to the declared low-risk apparel wholesaling profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Forward sales ledger with aging, inventory holding records, shipping schedule, supplier credit terms, warehouse contracts, and a treasury policy memorandum explaining settlement cycles and FX positions

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital generally routes via SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the shareholder's overseas bank to the company's USD account at a Samoa authorized dealer bank. For a Samoa International Company, the bank must receive evidence of the underlying equity or shareholder loan, the board resolution, and the account/instruction letter. The remittance narrative should include 'WS_IC capital injection / ISIC 4641 finished garments wholesale' with the appropriate purpose code. There is no mandatory central bank pre-approval for smaller equity injections under the delegated authority threshold, but the receiving bank will report on the Exchange Control form and may require additional UBO declarations. Compliance safeguards: use only the exact legal name of the company, include the Samoa bank SWIFT BIC, and avoid splitting payments to circumvent thresholds. The bank may require that the shareholder's account is in the same beneficial ownership name.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for purchasing finished garment lots from overseas suppliers are cleared via SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers or documentary Letters of Credit for larger and first-time transactions. For routine off-price liquidation trading, the preferred rail is an MT103 direct onward payment from the Samoa bank to the supplier's bank, accompanied by a stated purpose 'trade payment for finished garments / inventory clearance'. Commercial Letters of Credit provide a safer route when dealing with unknown suppliers and should be confirmed by a reputable outside bank. ACH is acceptable for small recurring payments to US-based service providers and escrow-type settlement platforms. The company must ensure that all payments are supported by invoices and that no payments are made to third parties without a valid trade underlying.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forwards with Samoa-licensed commercial banks for USD/WST trade-cover
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) arranged via offshore counterparties for WST exposure where onshore instruments are limited
Cross-currency swaps between USD and WST, subject to bank availability and exchange control approval
Limit/stop order conversion facilities with the bank's treasury desk
Plain-vanilla FX options, if commercially available, for firm trade commitments
Channeling FX conversion through the Samoa authorized dealer's daily interbank rate with no speculative instruments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Renewal and Government License Fee Payment (agent-filed)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), regulated under the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) framework
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each annual anniversary of incorporation; renewal window opens 30 days prior to the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a surcharge on arrears; if renewal fees remain unpaid for more than 3 months after the anniversary, the Registrar issues a strike-off notice and may administratively dissolve the company; reinstatement requires settlement of all arrears plus the prescribed restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Schedule Confirmation and AML/CFT Record Refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent; UBO data is accessible on demand to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, Central Bank of Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each incorporation anniversary; additionally, any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be advised within 14 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm UBO details allows the registered agent to file a suspicious transaction report with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and to resign; continuing non-compliance constitutes an offence under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2007, exposing the company and its responsible officers to fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Verification of On-Site Statutory Registers, Minute Book, and Compliance Certificate by Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent acting as keeper of the company's registered office records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, concurrent with the renewal filing and before the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government penalty attaches to this verification, but uncorrected deficiencies are recorded in the agent's compliance file and may trigger the agent's resignation notice; an unrepresented company is then exposed to strike-off by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None under the International Companies Act 1987. A standard Samoa International Company engaged exclusively in offshore wholesale activity is exempt from compulsory independent audit regardless of revenue or asset levels. An audit becomes mandatory only if the company holds a separate financial-services license or if shareholders pass a special resolution requiring auditor appointment.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutorily imposed GAAP for International Companies; records must fairly present commercial transactions and financial position. IFRS, as the base of Samoa's national accounting standards, is the accepted benchmark for voluntarily prepared accounts or audited engagements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent obtains a signed annual confirmation of the beneficial ownership schedule at each anniversary. Share transfers must be approved by directors, recorded in the Register of Members, and notified to the agent within 14 days. The agent must maintain UBO data under the AML/CFT framework and provide it to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful demand.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutory; USD 1,200 - 2,500 per annum if independently audited on a voluntary basis

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — International Company (IC) statutory exemption on all international business income under section 141 of the International Companies Act 1987; the Samoa domestic standard corporate income tax rate is 27% for entities not holding IC status.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Tax-exempt zone regime: 0% income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% gift, estate, inheritance and succession taxes, and 0% dividend withholding tax on IC distributions. The effective recurring fiscal burden is limited to the annual government licence fee (generally USD 100 to USD 1,000 depending on authorised share capital) and the annual return fee. No statutory trade licence is required for off-price wholesale liquidation of branded overstock apparel (ISIC 4641).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form ICAR-01) under section 141 of the International Companies Act 1987 — submitted to the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) through the MCIL Offshore e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of the certificate of incorporation; the annual government licence fee is payable concurrently.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company registration number and full legal name as recorded on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact IC number and English name; do not use abbreviated brand names.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in Samoa (physical street address and licensed registered agent details).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A P.O. Box alone is insufficient; provide the licensed Samoan registered agent's physical address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses and passport numbers of all directors and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must supply a certified copy of the passport bio-page and proof of residential address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued and authorised share capital, classes of shares, and consideration per share.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State currency (WST or USD); bearer shares must be declared as converted or immobilised.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration that no business is carried on in Samoa with Samoan residents, that no Samoa-situs property is held, and that no domestic banking restriction has been contravened.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A positive answer on any domestic taint question forfeits IC tax exemption and triggers the 27% domestic regime; obtain local legal advice before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation whether the company performs a relevant activity for Economic Substance Regulations purposes (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, holding, or intellectual property business).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Wholesale liquidation of finished garments should be mapped to distribution and service centre if purchasing, inventory risk-taking, marketing or resale functions are directed from Samoa; the answer must reconcile with the ESR Return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission triggers a penalty equal to the unpaid annual licence fee for each month or part of a month of default, suspension of the certificate of good standing, and administrative strike-off after six months of continuing default.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (ESR-01) under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations, as amended — electronically filed through the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of each financial year, unless the regulator directs a shorter filing window for the particular entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identity, jurisdiction of tax residence, and any tax residence certificates held in other jurisdictions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the IC is resident elsewhere, attach the foreign TRC; this flags treaty and substance-mismatch review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classification of the relevant activity carried on, including distribution and service centre, headquarters, IP business, or pure equity holding.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Classify accurately: an off-price apparel wholesaler earning purchase-resale margin must declare distribution and service centre if transactions are managed from Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income derived from the relevant activity in the reporting year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide gross income from garment liquidation activity in WST or USD; zero income returns attract audit review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Substance metrics: full-time employees, physical premises, operating expenditure, and place of board direction and management.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Employees and premises outside Samoa do not count; the company must demonstrate Samoan direction and management to satisfy ESR.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Supporting records: board meeting minutes, employment contracts, lease agreement, and profitability evidence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain English-documentation sets at the Samoan registered office; electronic storage is acceptable only if immediately accessible in Samoa.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed penalty up to WST 100,000 (approximately USD 36,500) plus daily surcharge until filed. Substantive ESR failure: penalty up to 100% of the income of the relevant activity, compulsory automatic exchange of information with foreign tax authorities, and disqualification or striking-off of the IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Income Tax Return (Form CIT-01) — Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) e-Tax electronic filing portal (required only if the IC loses exemption and becomes domestically taxable).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and full payment due within 12 months of the fiscal year-end; quarterly instalments apply to large taxpayers and to any entity reinvested as a domestic company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Assessable international business income exempt from Samoan tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter nil if the IC exemption is intact; attach the annual government fee receipt as proof of active status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoan-source trading income, including sales to Samoan residents or local warehouse operations in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any value here evidences domestic taint; remedy the exemption status before filing if the activity was inadvertent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and depreciation allowances admissible against taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations may deduct only expenses with a Samoan connection; cost of goods sold for garment purchases is admissible upon arm's-length invoicing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable or refund due at the 27% headline rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Final payment is due with the return; provisional tax and withholding tax credits must be reconciled.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% penalty on unpaid tax plus a 2% monthly compounding surcharge; false or misleading returns attract a 100% uplift of the tax shortfall and criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends and distributions made by an International Company to any shareholder, including non-residents, pursuant to the International Companies Act exemption; 15% final withholding tax applies to dividends paid by a domestic Samoan company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident seeking reduced treaty withholding tax must file a Withholding Tax Relief Application (Form WHT-ADJ) with the Samoa Revenue Authority before the payment date, attaching: (1) a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the tax authority of the recipient's residence, (2) a certificate of incorporation and ownership chain, (3) a beneficial ownership declaration, and (4) the specific DTA provision relied upon. The SRA issues a relief certificate or a withholding direction within 30 business days; relief is denied where the recipient is not the beneficial owner or holds no treaty access. Samoa's treaty network is narrow, with the principal example being the Samoa-New Zealand double taxation agreement; an International Company deriving exempt income normally cannot establish treaty residence because Samoa imposes no tax on its international income.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory gross-basis withholding tax of 15% on royalties and 15% on interest paid by a Samoan payer to non-residents; under the Samoa-New Zealand DTA the rates are reduced to a maximum of 10% on interest and 5% on royalties, subject to TRC and beneficial ownership confirmation. Related-party payments must be substantiated by contemporaneous arm's-length agreements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Samoa has no codified stand-alone transfer-pricing statute in force for International Companies, but the Commissioner of Inland Revenue adopts the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines and applies the arm's-length standard under the Income Tax Act general valuation and anti-avoidance powers. Local File-equivalent documentation is mandatory where connected-party cross-border transactions exceed WST 1,000,000 (approximately USD 370,000) per annum; a Master File and Samoa Country-by-Country report are required where the Samoa-resident ultimate parent group has consolidated group revenue above WST 35,000,000 (approximately USD 13,000,000).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations, as amended, impose a mandatory economic substance test on every International Company performing a relevant activity. Relevant activities include banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, holding company, and intellectual property business. The off-price wholesale liquidation of finished garments (ISIC 4641) will be treated as a distribution and service centre to the extent that purchasing, inventory risk-taking, marketing, or resale functions are directed from Samoa. The company must demonstrate in Samoa: (1) direction and management, evidenced by board meetings held and minutes kept in Samoa; (2) an adequate physical office; (3) full-time employees proportionate to its income; and (4) operating expenditure proportionate to its income. Pure equity holding companies benefit from reduced substance requirements. Failure exposes the company to fixed penalties up to WST 100,000, reassessment of profits, automatic exchange of information, and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting fabricated annual returns, ESR returns, or financial statements to conceal gross garment-trading income, or knowingly claiming the 0% exemption while conducting Samoan domestic business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil: 100% shortfall penalty on the unpaid 27% tax, a 2% monthly late-payment surcharge, and reassessment of all worldwide income. Criminal: fine up to WST 100,000 (corporate fine up to WST 250,000) and imprisonment up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil where the filing was directed by an officer: directors become jointly and severally liable for the tax, penalties, and costs; prosecution carries travel bans, freezing of foreign assets, and imprisonment of the responsible director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a nominee-only presence in Samoa without real employees, premises, or board activity, while routing garment-liquidation margins through Samoa to secure the tax-exempt status or a treaty benefit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed penalty up to WST 100,000 per contravention plus daily surcharge; the regulator may strike the company off the register and exchange information with the foreign tax administration of the beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the Samoan registered agent are liable for the penalties where they participated in the facade; disqualification from acting as a director for up to 10 years, travel-ban enforcement pending examination, and personal restitution of fees improperly saved.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An International Company carrying on business with Samoan residents, holding land or shares in Samoan domestic companies, opening a local bank account for Samoan-source sales of branded overstock garments, or otherwise exceeding the offshore-only scope.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate forfeiture of IC exemption; assessment on worldwide income at 27%, penalty surcharge up to 20% of the tax assessed, deregistration, and a fine up to WST 50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for restitution of the tax avoided on a joint-and-several basis; the court may order asset tracing, travel bans, and imprisonment up to 5 years for a knowing contravention.
